row: Hi I'm Danielle and I am an equine physical therapist based in the UK.  I have been living my best life as an equine therapist since 2009 and I LOVE my work.  I use a range of different modalities including sports massage, trigger point therapy, Masterson Method and myofascial release for injury prevention, injury rehabilitation and to work towards optimum performance.  I am lucky enough to work on a wide range of horses from adored leisure horses and treasured golden oldies to performance horses working at the highest levels and I learn from each and every one of them - every day's a school day!  I hope you enjoy browsing my videos and I would love to hear from you either here or at my FB page - just search danielle equine sports massage.  Enjoy! X.
